title: Jazzy Italian Ricotta Ravioli
description: A creative twist on traditional ricotta ravioli, made with jazzy flair and inspired by the Italian countryside. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Combine ricotta, jazzy, curry, and egg in a bowl. Mix well.
Add flour and salt to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter.
Place a spoonful of ricotta mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a ravioli shape.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the ravioli for 3-5 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve.
